newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Banca Quadrum Q2 loss 4.4 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Banca Quadrum Q2 loss 4.4 mln pesos.

text.p: Mexico's Banca Quadrum reported a loss of 4.4 million pesos in the second quarter, but it said its other financial indicators improved.
It gave no comparative figures, but according to previously released data, it had a first quarter loss of 9.13 million pesos.
Its index of past-due loans fell to 10.3 percent in the quarter from 10.5 percent on March 31. Its capitalization index on June 30 was 16.9 percent.

Banca Quadrum was set up in November 1994, just before the December peso devaluation. It said it was the only bank in the Mexican system with loans issued before the devaluation that has received no support from the government.
